title: SvgFeBlend
responsibility: Renders the native feBlend element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgFeBlend.children
inputs.description: Optional Snippet that supplies content inside the feBlend element, rendered with `{@render children()}` (no arguments) only when the value is truthy. It is excluded from the forwarded attributes; when it is omitted (undefined), nothing is rendered inside the element, and the component does not check the value beyond that truthiness test.

outputs.name: SvgFeBlend
outputs.description: The native feBlend element in the SVG namespace, with every prop except children forwarded to it through the attribute spread and the children snippet rendered inside it when provided. The template adds no wrapper element and no default attributes, and the component itself does not validate or change any forwarded value.
